rationale: Because nearly every mid-to-large firm reports some debt issuance, `MIN(dvt+prstkc, sstk+dltis)` will usually bind on the distribution side, so the weight collapses to total payout/assets and the signal degenerates into the already-archived payout-intensity × operating-cash-flow interaction (Dividend Commitment Meets Cash Cover, Dividend Rigidity Meets Cash Generation) rather than testing simultaneity; it also changes both legs at once, so any result is uninterpretable as a test of the stated mechanism.

The one-variable isolation is methodologically clean and the debt-funded-dividend mechanism is economically distinct, but for the large majority of dividend payers `dltis > dvt`, so `MIN(dvt, dltis)` reduces to `dvt` and the construction risks reproducing the archived dividend-commitment × cash-cover signal (fmb 2.80, alpha 2.7%) with only a coverage screen attached — the proposal needs a binding-fraction diagnostic or a ratio-of-overlap formulation before it is worth a slot.

target_name: Dividend Rigidity Against Maintenance Free Cash
rationale: Netting depreciation is economically defensible, but `oancf - dp` is very highly correlated with `oancf` in the cross-section and the weight leg is unchanged from Dividend Rigidity Meets Cash Generation, so this is close to a cosmetic re-specification whose result is likely to land within noise of the archived 2.7% alpha rather than a substantively different test.

The diagnosis is correct and important — under COALESCE-to-zero the tied mass of non-innovators still receives a nonzero rank weight and injects the plain net-issuance anomaly into the archive's headline fmb 5.12 — and setting that mass to an exact zero weight is a genuine construction fix rather than a variant, though the un-industry-adjusted raw R&D/sales weight will concentrate the tails in biotech/tech and should be monitored for industry-driven alpha.

The five-year downside floor is a genuinely new and economically appropriate statistic for a fixed-commitment question and is not a repackaging of the level/volatility legs already tested, but `TS_MIN` is unwinsorized before `IND_ZSCORE` (one catastrophic year drives the whole conditioner) and the min is strongly correlated with the mean cash-flow level, so the incremental content over the archived cash-cover signals may be small.

`MIN(dvt,sstk)/(dvt+sstk)` is bounded in [0,0.5] and maximized by any firm whose dividend and issuance happen to be equal — including trivially tiny matched flows — so it strips out exactly the economic magnitude that made the parent signal work and loads the tails with noise, and it is undefined when both flows are zero (a large fraction of the sample).
